pure-announcement.rationale: This is Grafana's own GrafanaCON announcement that it donated Beyla to OpenTelemetry - donation news, contributor thanks, and repo roadmap - and the zero-code-instrumentation rationale appears only as backstory justifying that news.

duplicate.rationale: None of the six nearest concepts (OSV format, SIEM gap, evals, retrieval, Code Mode, Agent Skills) touch eBPF instrumentation or the Beyla donation.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The donation, code drop, and due-diligence process are all linked to public GitHub issues and documents a reader can verify.

durability.rationale: The lasting residue is only that OTel eBPF Instrumentation originated from Beyla; the donation timeline, acceptance-criteria status, and 100k-pulls-per-month figures are news that expires quickly.

actionability.rationale: It tells a reader the tool exists for the can't-instrument-the-source niche and to join the SIG, but offers no steps or trade-offs that would change how they build.

atomicity.rationale: The whole piece states one event - Beyla becomes OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation and the Beyla repo becomes a downstream wrapper - which fits in a single paragraph.
